retrievalProfile.description: A warm, close-up male portrait featuring a high-contrast mix of ultra-bold geometric sans-serif and elegant decorative script.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, warm-toned portrait of a smiling man in a blue shirt, framed by heavy, vibrant red block lettering at the top left and a delicate white script subtitle tucked beneath it.
coreVisualRelationships: Heavy red display type anchored to the top-left corner
Delicate white script providing a textural contrast to the blocky header
Warm, shallow-depth-of-field background with domestic interior hints
Subject's face as the central focal point with a direct gaze
coreInvariants: Ultra-bold, tight-kerning sans-serif for the primary name
High-contrast script with prominent swashes for the title
Warm, saturated color palette dominated by reds, browns, and blues

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, centered horizontally, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold red text in the upper-left quadrant acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red header, moves down to the white script, then settles on the subject's face and smile.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, out-of-focus background elements provide breathing room around the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and reds in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool medium blue of the subject's shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant tomato red for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red text against a moderately saturated, warm-toned photographic base.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones, primary red, and sky blue

letterConstructionRules: Display type uses extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
Script type features high stroke contrast and circular swash terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight letter spacing in the display font to create a solid block of color
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast between a heavy geometric sans and a light, decorative script.
graphicDevices: Small technical metadata text at the very top edge
Small production credits in the bottom-left corner

preserve: Red color for the main name
avoid: Serif fonts for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky presence of the primary name.
Captures the formal, swashed elegance of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned, 1960s style studio portrait of a smiling man in a blue button-down shirt, with a soft-focus interior background featuring warm wood and red tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in ultra-bold red sans-serif at the top left. Below it, add the title in white decorative script with large swashes, centered relative to the red text block.

verificationChecks: Is the red text ultra-bold and tightly spaced?
Does the script text have elegant swashes?
Is the overall color temperature warm and nostalgic?
Is the portrait centered and smiling?

adjustableVariables: Specific red hue of the text
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text does not bleed into the subject's hair
Ensure the script is legible against the background
Verify the 'Stereo' text is small and centered at the top
Confirm the portrait has a natural, warm skin tone
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a warm studio portrait + add ultra-bold red sans-serif header + add white swash script subtitle.
